api.notes: Named slot per A§7.2; unnamed content is projected into the same circle (the natural way to write it).

api.reason: A-xstyle: use class/style, ::part(base) or the tokens.

differences.text: The host is inline-flex (upstream's root is a block-level flex span that only ever sits inside a flex container); the circle keeps its fixed 32px size and never shrinks.
The circle carries a transparent 1px border so forced colours draw its edge; the box stays 32px (border-box). Fill and ink are --color-accent / --color-on-accent, the Tecton primary-action pair.

core.nav-icon.notes: Guides: [mwg:shadow-dom] slots; [mwg:styling-web-components] parts and slotted sizing; [mwg:css] forced colours.
